formulations: Finished dosage forms — tablets, capsules, etc.
contract manufacturing: CMO/CDMO — makes drugs for other brands.
bulk drug: Bulk drug / API manufacturing (matches bulk drugs in About).
connectors: Connectors — plural form in About text.
launch vehicles: Launch vehicles — plural form in About (not launch + vehicle).
power transformer: Grid-scale transformers for DC / industrial loads.
battery energy storage: BESS for backup and peak shaving.
bus bars: Bus bars — matches About text (bus bar alone does not match bus bars).
copper rods: Copper rods — plural form in About (Sunlite, Apar).
amalgamation: Scheme of amalgamation / merger of companies.
rights issue: Rights issue — capital raise / arbitrage setups.
NCLT: National Company Law Tribunal — insolvency forum.
REPM: Rare Earth Permanent Magnet — NdFeB/SmCo magnets for EV traction motors, wind generators, and defense guidance systems.
NdFeB: Neodymium-Iron-Boron; strongest commercial permanent magnet alloy (often absent from Screener About — use ferrites/traction motor proxies).
SmCo: Samarium-Cobalt; high-temperature rare earth magnet for aerospace and defense motors.
hard ferrites: Sintered ferrite magnets used in automotive magnetos, alternators, and small motors (Delta Manufacturing).
flywheel magneto: Magneto-based ignition assembly — stator/rotor magnet stack (India Nippon).
traction motors: EV/rail propulsion motor — primary downstream demand driver for REPM (Sona Comstar, Varroc, Hirect).
BLDC motors: Brushless DC motors using permanent-magnet rotors (Ram Ratna Wires).
heavy mineral sand: Beach-sand feedstock for monazite/rutile — upstream rare earth corridor (Midwest, NMDC).
monazite: Mineral sand containing rare earth phosphates; IREL/NLC processing chain feedstock.
magnet winding wires: Enamelled copper for motor windings — adjacent to magnet/motor supply chain.
REPM scheme: ₹7,280 crore PLI to build ~6,000 MTPA domestic REPM capacity (news/research terms).
ISM 2.0: India Semiconductor Mission 2.0; ₹1.25 lakh crore commitment for fab, ATMP, and indigenous chip design.
Electronics Component Manufacturing Sche: ₹40,000 crore outlay to localize the $40B electronics component import bill (PCBs, displays, sensors).
SPECS: Scheme for Promotion of Manufacturing of Electronic Components and Semiconductors; provides 25% capex subsidy.
EMS: Electronics Manufacturing Services — contract design/build of PCBs and box-builds (Kaynes, Syrma, Dixon).
ESDM: Electronics System Design & Manufacturing — India policy umbrella for local electronics value chain.
semiconductor packaging: ATMP/OSAT-style backend chip packaging and testing in India.
PLI + electronics: Production Linked Incentive for large-scale electronics / mobile / component manufacturing.
indigenous IP + semiconductor: Government push for domestic fabless design companies to own core chip architecture rather than just assembling.
Data centre + tax holiday: Income tax exemptions extended until 2047 for global cloud providers setting up Indian data centers.
India AI Mission: ₹10,372 crore allocation for domestic AI compute infrastructure, startup grants, and sovereign LLM development.
sovereign AI: Government-backed initiative to build indigenous large language models and secure domestic AI compute stacks.
AI compute: GPU/accelerator clusters for training and inference — India AI Mission demand driver.
electric ambulance: ₹500 crore specific allocation to modernize emergency response fleets with EVs.
EV infrastructure fund: ₹2,000 crore outlay for highway charging networks, battery swapping grids, and depot charging.
FAME III: Expected successor to FAME II, focusing on commercial EV fleets and localized battery cell manufacturing.
FAME: Faster Adoption and Manufacturing of Electric Vehicles — demand/supply incentives for EVs.
e-mobility: Electric mobility stack — vehicles, motors, batteries, and charging.
battery swapping: Swap-station model for 2W/3W/commercial EVs — policy-supported alternative to slow charging.
regional medical hub: 5 mega-hospitals built in PPP mode to decentralize quaternary care and reduce medical tourism leakage.
PM-JAY + 70+: Extension of ₹5 lakh annual health cover to all senior citizens (70+), massively expanding the insured patient pool for private hospitals.
Ayushman Bharat: National health protection / wellness-centre umbrella that expands insured inpatient volumes.
multispecialty hospital: Private hospital chains offering multi-specialty tertiary/quaternary care — primary PM-JAY capacity.
medical tourism: Inbound elective care — policy push to keep volumes in Indian hubs.
SME Growth Fund: ₹10,000 crore corpus to provide equity and subordinate debt to job-creating MSMEs.
Self-Reliant India Fund: ₹2,000 crore top-up specifically for micro-enterprise risk capital and grassroots entrepreneurship.
CGTMSE: Credit Guarantee Fund Trust for Micro and Small Enterprises; the backbone of collateral-free MSME lending in India.
MSME: Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises — formalization and credit push via Udyam / CGTMSE / TReDS.
microfinance: Unsecured micro-loans to micro-enterprises and households — listed NBFC-MFIs and SFBs.
TReDS: Trade Receivables Discounting System — invoice discounting platform for MSME cash-flow.
PM Surya Ghar: Flagship scheme providing up to ₹78,000 subsidy per household for rooftop solar, targeting 1 crore homes.
decentralized renewable: Shift from utility-scale solar parks to distributed, behind-the-meter residential and commercial solar.
rooftop EPC: Engineering, Procurement, and Construction players specifically executing residential and SME solar installations.
rooftop solar: Behind-the-meter PV on homes/SMEs — core PM Surya Ghar demand.
solar module: Crystalline / thin-film PV modules and cells — domestic manufacturing under ALMM/PLI.
National Fibre Scheme: Umbrella scheme integrating natural (jute, silk, wool) and man-made fibers (MMF) to achieve self-reliance.
man-made fibre: MMF (polyester, viscose); the high-growth segment of global textiles where India is aggressively trying to capture Bangladesh/Vietnam market share.
MITRA park: Mega Investment Textiles and Apparel parks; integrated plug-and-play infrastructure for global apparel brands.
technical textiles: Non-apparel industrial textiles (auto, geotextile, medical) — PLI priority segment.
home textiles: Bed/bath/kitchen textiles — large listed exporters (Welspun, Indo Count, Trident).
Gati Shakti: National Master Plan for multi-modal connectivity; digitally integrates all infrastructure ministries to eliminate project delays.
IMEEC: India-Middle East-Europe Economic Corridor; massive rail and shipping corridor bypassing traditional routes to accelerate export logistics.
multimodal logistics park: MMLPs; integrated hubs combining rail, road, and warehousing to reduce India's logistics cost from 14% to 8% of GDP.
ULIP: Unified Logistics Interface Platform; the digital API backbone of the National Logistics Policy.
National Logistics Policy: Policy to cut logistics cost and digitize freight via ULIP, MMLPs, and multimodal corridors.
Atal Pension Yojana: APY; guaranteed old-age income security scheme targeting the massive unorganized sector workforce.
PMJJBY: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana; government-backed micro-life insurance driving massive premium volume for private insurers.
financial inclusion + JAM: Jan Dhan-Aadhaar-Mobile trinity; the digital rail enabling direct benefit transfers and mass-market financialization.
PMSBY: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana — government accident micro-insurance.
life insurance: Life / ULIP / annuity books that distribute APY and PMJJBY-style products at scale.
data centre tax holiday: Income tax exemptions extended until 2047 for global cloud providers setting up Indian data centers.
SPECS scheme: Scheme for Promotion of Manufacturing of Electronic Components and Semiconductors; provides 25% capex subsidy.
ATMP: Assembly, Testing, Marking and Packaging — semiconductor backend operations.
PCB assembly: PCBA / SMT line assembly for EMS and ODMs.
charging station: Public / depot EV chargers — EV infrastructure fund demand driver.
PLI + food processing: Production Linked Incentive for food processing — aseptic packaging, sprays, and value-added exports.
MoFPI + incentive: Ministry of Food Processing Industries grants for aseptic lines and spray-dried powders.
aseptic + PLI: Subsidies targeting shelf-stable packaging formats vs traditional canning.
food processing: Value-added processing of agri produce — core MoFPI / PLI beneficiary set.
aseptic: Aseptic filling / packaging for pulp, puree, dairy — PLI-favoured format.
ready to eat: RTE / convenience foods — packaged foods exporters and domestic brands.
fruit pulp: Fruit pulp / concentrate for exports and beverage blenders.
cold storage: Cold storage / controlled atmosphere — food value-chain infrastructure.
edible oil: Edible oil refining / packing — large listed processors.
3PL: Third-party logistics providers — warehousing, freight, last-mile.
cold chain: Temperature-controlled logistics for food/pharma — NLP priority.
